translation: Sweet in flavor, neutral. It expels edema and distention (逐水脹), removes heat-bi of the stomach (胃中熱痹), injury of the center (傷中), dribbling exposure (淋露), sends down stagnant blood (下瘀血), disperses the binding accumulations and internal cold of the five viscera (散五臟結積、內寒), and kills wu [blank]. Taken for a long time it makes the body heavy. The roasted dregs (熬屑), sweet in flavor.
